_about: Plain-language descriptions for the reference, checked against the APS 3.0 source. An entry here replaces the source's doc comment (written for whoever maintains the plugin) for that member. Keys: Owner.Member, Enum.Value, or a type name for its own description.
UAPSStanceProvider.GetAPSStance: Implement it to tell APS the posture: Standing, Crouched or Prone.
UAPSFusionPolicy.FuseConfidence: Override it: combine this update's sense readings into one confidence, 0 to 1. Samples has one entry per sense, in the profile's order (Sense ID, Confidence, Weight, Is Active). Corroboration Bonus is the profile's, for reference.
UAPSThreatPolicy.ScoreThreat: Override it: return how dangerous the target is, 0 to 1. Record is everything the AI believes about the target; Relationship comes from its APS Relationship. APS still turns the score into a level with the profile's thresholds, and keeps Friendly, Teammate and Expired targets at None.
UAPSAttentionPolicy.SelectAttentionTarge: Override it: return the target the AI should commit to, Current to keep it, or none. Candidates are the actors it holds beliefs about, best first. Time on Current is how long it has held Current; Stickiness Time and Switch Threshold are the profile's, so you can honour them. It replaces the built-in rule entirely.
UAPSSignificancePolicy.ScoreSignificance: Override it: return how important this AI is, 0 to 1. More important AI update more often and win the frame budget. Nearest Viewer Dist is the distance to the closest player camera in cm (0 on a dedicated server); Is Engaged is true while its awareness is Suspicious or higher; Awareness is 0 (Unaware) to 4 (Fully Aware).
UAPSTargetComponent.GetEffectiveStance: The posture in effect now. With Auto Detect Stance on: what an APSStance Provider or the Character's crouch reports, or this component's Stance when that says Standing. With it off: Stance.
UPerceptionCore.GetSourceProfile: The profile asset you assigned, before its parent and any overrides are applied.
UPerceptionCore.SetProfileNumber: Change one number on this AI's profile now, for this AI only: it gets a private copy, and the asset and other AI are untouched. Property is the setting's override name, shown on the profile reference (for example VisionMaxRange). Returns false, and logs, when no setting has that name. Nothing the AI believes is reset.
UPerceptionCore.SetProfileFlag: Like Set Profile Number, for a tickbox. A tickbox's override name keeps its b, for example bEnablePeripheralCone.
UPerceptionCore.GetProfileNumber: Read one number from this AI's profile by its override name. Returns Fallback when no setting has that name.
UPerceptionCore.GetAttentionTarget: The one target this AI focuses on, among those it has noticed (Suspected or more). It is sticky (Attention Stickiness Time, Attention Switch Threshold), so a slightly better rival doesn't take it. It can be one the AI only suspects, or a teammate: check Get Awareness Level for Target before chasing it. None when there is no one.
UPerceptionCore.GetAttentionDuration: How long, in seconds, it has been focused on its current attention target: for an I've-chased-this-too-long check.
UPerceptionCore.ForceAttentionTarget: Make this its attention target now, ignoring stickiness: when the player shoots this AI, say. Gives the AI a belief about the target if it had none. If the AI never notices that target, the focus lets go after the stickiness time.
UPerceptionCore.GetTopTarget: The target with the best sort score right now, among those the AI has noticed (Suspected or more). It can change often.
UPerceptionCore.GetTargetsSortedByScore: Every actor this AI holds a belief about, best sort score first, even ones still Undetected. Never things (APS Evidence: see Get Perceived Objects), places or Expired beliefs.
UPerceptionCore.GetSenseResult: Everything one sense reported about a target the last time it ran: its confidence, where it placed the target, and for vision the exposure, the visible points, the cone, the light and the blocker. Senses run on their own intervals, so Is Active is false between their updates: use Was Active Last Eval to ask whether it perceives the target now. False when the AI holds no belief about the target or runs no such sense.
UPerceptionCore.GetEyeViewPoint: Where this AI's eyes are and which way they look, as vision uses them: the eye socket (with Use Eye Socket) or the actor plus Eye Height Offset, facing with Eye Direction Mode and Eye Turn Rate applied. Use it to draw the real cone or aim a head or a flashlight.
UPerceptionCore.GetVisionFans: Each of this AI's view cones as a flat fan whose edge stops where sight stops: at a wall, past glass as far as sight gets through, at full range in the open. Re-traced when the eyes move or turn, otherwise about twelve times a second, so it is cheap to call every frame. False with no Vision sense.
UPerceptionCore.GetSamplePoints: Vision's sample points on a target and how much sight reaches each (Seen, Partly, Blocked): the same points and traces vision uses. A head over a wall is one Seen point and four Blocked. It traces once per point, so ask about one target at a time. False with no Vision sense or no target.
UPerceptionCore.GetLossReason: Why the AI last lost this target: Occluded, OutOfRange, SoundFaded, ScentLost, SensorDropout or TargetDestroyed. Unknown if it never lost it or has found it again. Branch your search on it.
UPerceptionCore.GetLossDirection: Which way the target was moving when it was last lost, from its last measured velocity. (0, 0, 0) when it wasn't moving.
UPerceptionCore.GetRecentEpisodes: This AI's last five encounters with the target, oldest first: how each ended, where, which way the target went and how long it lasted. False until the AI has lost the target at least once from Detected or Tracked.
UPerceptionCore.GetLastEpisode: The most recent encounter with the target. False when there is none yet.
UPerceptionCore.ClearEpisodes: Forget this AI's encounter history with a target: a new game, a respawn.
UPerceptionCore.SetEmotion: Set one emotion, 0 to 1, once. The emotion rules carry on from there on the next update; for lasting fear, use Set Fear Input.
UPerceptionCore.ResetEmotionalState: Set every emotion, and the fear input, to 0: Calm.
UPerceptionCore.SetFearInput: An outside source of fear, 0 to 1, that lasts until you change it: a horror event, a roar. Above 0 it makes fear rise, faster the higher it is; above 0.9 it raises panic. 0 lets fear fade by the rules.
UPerceptionCore.SetTargetConfidence: Raise this AI's confidence in a target to at least this value, once, at any range: a tip-off, an alarm. It never lowers belief, and afterwards belief fades as usual unless a sense keeps it up. To cap, lower or clear belief, or to make a change last, use Add Target Evidence.
UPerceptionCore.AddTargetEvidence: Hold belief about a target at a floor (Raise), under a ceiling (Clamp), lower than the senses say (Lower) or at zero (Invalidate). It applies every update after the senses, so a Clamp holds even while the AI sees the target. The same Evidence Tag again replaces the entry. Lifetime 0 lasts until removed; Source is a label for your own debugging.
UPerceptionCore.RemoveTargetEvidence: Remove one piece of evidence about a target, by its tag. True if there was one.
UPerceptionCore.ClearTargetEvidence: Remove every piece of evidence about a target.
UPerceptionCore.GetTargetEvidence: The evidence applied to a target now, each with its operation, value, lifetime, age and source.
UPerceptionCore.ReportTouchContact: Report a contact yourself: who, what kind (Bump, Grab, Collision, Explosion), how strong (0 to 1), whether it is held (until End Touch Contact) and where. Touch wires the AI's own hits and overlaps by itself; use this for anything else. Needs Touch Sense.
UPerceptionCore.ReportTouchContactWithIm: Report a contact from a physics hit: the impulse sets the strength (Touch Max Impulse for Full Strength counts as full).
UPerceptionCore.EndTouchContact: End a held contact (a grab, an overlap) reported earlier.
UPerceptionCore.ReportPainFromDefinition: Add pain of one type (a Pain Type Definition asset): it dulls the senses the asset lists, and fades at its Decay Rate. On AI Pain Reported fires on the next update. Needs Pain Sense in the profile; an amount of 0 or less does nothing.
UPerceptionCore.ClearPainFromDefinition: Remove all pain of one type: a medkit, an extinguisher.
UPerceptionCore.ClearAllPain: Remove all pain of every type.
UPerceptionCore.SetPainTypeEnabledFromDe: Turn one pain type off or on for this AI: immunity. While off it ignores reports and dulls nothing, and its level waits, unfaded.
UPerceptionCore.GetPainLevelFromDefiniti: One pain type's level now, 0 to 1.
UPerceptionCore.GetTotalPainLevel: Every enabled pain type's level added up, at most 1.
UPerceptionCore.ReportVibrationEvent: Report a vibration nobody's footsteps made (a grenade, a collapse) at a place. The AI feels the place, not whoever stands near it. Moving actors are felt by themselves. Needs Vibration Sense.
UPerceptionCore.BroadcastAlertToSquad: Tell squadmates about a place and a threat level without sharing a belief about anyone: I heard something over there. On AI Squad Alert fires on them.
UPerceptionCore.GetSenseBlocker: Why one sense reported nothing about a target the last time it ran: out of range, outside the cones, hidden, too few points showing, the reaction window... Only Vision gives reasons; other senses say None. None also when the sense did report the target.
UPerceptionCore.ExplainPerception: A short text report of what this AI believes about a target: its state by name and how sure it is as a percentage, then each sense, active with its confidence or silent with the reason. For a debug key or the log.
UPerceptionCore.StartRecording: Start keeping a rolling record of what this AI believes: the last Seconds of it. Starting again throws away what was recorded. While on, it costs one small frame per believed actor per update.
UPerceptionCore.IsLocationInNeverSearchZ: True when the location is inside a never-search zone registered on the APS Subsystem; always false when this AI's profile has Respect Never Search Zones off. APS doesn't enforce zones: your search logic asks this.
UPerceptionCore.ReportLocationBelief: Tell this AI something happened at a place with no known author: where, what kind of thing (Tag), how strongly it registered (Confidence, 0 to 1) and how precisely it is placed (Accuracy, 0 to 1). Reports close together with the same tag merge into one belief.
UPerceptionCore.GetLocationBeliefs: Every belief about a place this AI holds, strongest first.
UPerceptionCore.GetStrongestLocationBeli: Its strongest belief about a place. False when it holds none.
UPerceptionCore.ClearLocationBelief: Drop a belief about a place: it checked, and there was nothing.
UAPSSubsystem.SetEnvironmentState: Set the world's light, rain, wind, indoors and time of day in one call.
UAPSSubsystem.RegisterNeverSearchZone: Mark a sphere as a safe place: a save room, a locker. APS doesn't enforce it: your search and chase logic asks Is Location in Never Search Zone before sending an AI there.
UAPSSubsystem.IsInNeverSearchZone: True when the location is inside any registered never-search zone, whatever any AI's profile says.
UAPSSubsystem.RegisterPerceivableActor: Let AI perceive an actor that isn't a Pawn (Pawns are found by themselves). An APS Target Component does this for its actor. Unregister it at End Play.
UAPSSubsystem.UnregisterPerceivableActor: Stop AI perceiving an actor you registered with Register Perceivable Actor.
UAPSSubsystem.GetEnvironmentAt: The conditions at a point: the world's, with the APS Environment sphere that covers the point applied (only the winning one, where they overlap).
UAPSSubsystem.GetSenseRangeScaleAt: How far a sense reaches at a point, as a multiplier from the APS Environment sphere there (1 elsewhere). Sense ID: Vision, Hearing or Smell; anything else gives 1.
UAPSSubsystem.GetAgentSignificance: An AI's latest significance score, 0 to 1: what picks its level of detail. For tuning.
UAPSSubsystem.EmitStimulus: Send your own tagged signal to every AI that listens for it. Skipped: AI beyond Radius, above Max LODTier, on the source's team (with Team Filter) or behind a wall (with Requires Clear Path). Of the built-in senses only Vibration listens; your own C++ senses can.
UPerceptionSoundSystem.EmitSound: Make a noise someone made (Source): a footstep, a shot, a reload. AI within the Sound Type's Max Range hear it, muffled by walls, and their belief is about the Source. Call it on the server, from any Blueprint.
UPerceptionSoundSystem.EmitSoundAtLocati: Make a noise nobody made, at a place: an explosion, a trap, a can landing. AI within the Sound Type's Max Range form a belief about the place, not about anyone. Call it on the server, from any Blueprint.
URelationshipComponent.GetRelationship: What this AI takes an actor for: its override if it has one, else the class rule, else the team rule, else Default Relationship.
URelationshipComponent.SetRelationshipOv: Decide what this AI takes one actor for, now, over every rule: the player in a uniform as Friendly, a recruit as Teammate.
USenseUnit.Evaluate: Override it in your own sense: judge one target and fill in Out Result (Is Active, Confidence, Estimated Location, Location Accuracy, Sense ID).
USenseUnit.GetSenseID: Override it in your own sense: return its name, for example Thermal. It is what Get Sense Contributions and the Visualizer show.
USenseUnit_Pain.ReportPainFromDefinition: Add pain of one type. From Blueprint, use the APS Core's node of the same name.
USenseUnit_Pain.GetTotalPainLevel: Every enabled pain type's level added up, at most 1.
USenseUnit_Pain.ClearPainFromDefinition: Remove all pain of one type.
USenseUnit_Pain.ClearAllPain: Remove all pain of every type.
USenseUnit_Pain.SetPainTypeEnabledFromDe: Turn one pain type off or on.
USenseUnit_Pain.SetHealthRatio: Set the health fraction, 0 to 1. It sticks only while nothing on the AI answers the health lookup; otherwise the next update overwrites it.
USenseUnit_Smell.SetWindDirection: Give this smell sense its own wind direction, over the world's: the way the air moves. (0, 0, 0) uses the world's wind.
USenseUnit_Touch.ReportContact: Report a contact: who, what kind, how strong (0 to 1), whether it is held, and where. From Blueprint, use the APS Core's Report Touch Contact.
USenseUnit_Touch.ReportContactWithImpuls: Report a contact from a physics hit; the impulse sets the strength. From Blueprint, use the APS Core's Report Touch Contact with Impulse.
USenseUnit_Touch.EndTouchContact: End a held contact. From Blueprint, use the APS Core's End Touch Contact.
USenseUnit_Vibration.ReportVibrationEven: Report a vibration at a place: where, how strong (0 to 1) and on what surface. From Blueprint, use the APS Core's Report Vibration Event.
UAPSDescriptorLibrary.MatchAgainst: How well Description fits Known, 0 to 1. Only keys both have are compared, and each contradiction halves the score: the same rule Match Descriptor uses.
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.ReportObservation: Tell a faction something, at once and complete. It merges with an entry about the same actor, or one whose description matches, so ten sightings stay one manhunt. Returns the entry's id, or -1 if nothing was recorded.
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.MatchDescriptor: Who does the faction know of that fits this description? Returns the best match and how well it fits, 0 to 1; you decide whether that is enough to act on.
UAPSKnowledgeSubsystem.GetFactionAlert: How alarmed a faction is, 0 to 1: a wanted level.
UAPSObserverComponent.GetObservationQual: How good a look this AI has at a target now, 0 to 1, from how sure it is and how far away the target is. It decides which traits it can make out.
UAPSSearchComponent.GetSearchProgress: How much of the reachable area has been checked, 0 to 1.
UAPSSignatureComponent.GetObservedSubset: The traits an observer makes out with a look this good (0 to 1): a trait is noticed when its Observability is at least 1 minus the quality, so a poor look gets only the obvious ones.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAISee: Fires each time vision (or echolocation) reports the target: about every 0.15 s while it is seen.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIHear: Fires on each hearing update that hears the target: when a sound of theirs arrives, and again on each update after it while the built-up noise lasts. On those build-up updates Sound Type Name is None and Location is where the target is now, not where the sound was. For one event per sound, use On Sound Heard.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAISmell: Fires each time smell reports the target: about every 0.25 s while it smells them.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIFeel: Fires when touch reports a contact from the target.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAISenseVibratio: Fires when vibration reports something: a target's footsteps, or a vibration at a place. No line of sight needed.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAISuspect: A target entered Suspected: from Undetected, or stepping down from Detected.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIDetect: A target entered Detected: from Suspected, stepping down from Tracked, or found again after Lost or Remembered.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAITrack: A target entered Tracked: high, sustained confidence.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAILost: A target entered Lost. Gives where it was last placed, where it is predicted to be, and the cover it went behind.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIRemember: A lost target faded to Remembered. Age Seconds is the time since the AI first noticed it.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIForget: The AI let go of a target: it Expired, or dropped back to Undetected.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIAllClear: No actor is left at Suspected, Detected, Tracked or Lost (Get Active Target Count fell to 0): time to stand down.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIPainReported: Fires for each Report Pain from Definition, on the next update: Pain Type (the asset's name), Pain Level (after that report), Threshold Crossed (always -1, kept for older Blueprints) and Pain Def (the asset).
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAIDamaged: Fires on every Unreal damage call that hits the AI (Apply Damage, Apply Point Damage, Apply Radial Damage), with or without Damage Sense: who did it, how much, the damage type's short tag and where.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAISquadAlert: A squadmate told this AI something new: a shared target, or a place and threat (Broadcast Alert to Squad). It doesn't fire again for the same news.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnLocationBeliefC: A belief about a place (a noise nobody made, a blast) changed state.
UPerceptionCore.OnAISee: Fires each time vision (or echolocation) reports the target: about every 0.15 s while it is seen.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIHear: Fires on each hearing update that hears the target: when a sound of theirs arrives, and again on each update after it while the built-up noise lasts. On those build-up updates Sound Type Name is None and Location is where the target is now, not where the sound was. For one event per sound, use On Sound Heard.
UPerceptionCore.OnAISmell: Fires each time smell reports the target: about every 0.25 s while it smells them.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIFeel: Fires when touch reports a contact from the target.
UPerceptionCore.OnAISenseVibration: Fires when vibration reports something: a target's footsteps, or a vibration at a place. No line of sight needed.
UPerceptionCore.OnAISuspect: A target entered Suspected: from Undetected, or stepping down from Detected.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIDetect: A target entered Detected: from Suspected, stepping down from Tracked, or found again after Lost or Remembered.
UPerceptionCore.OnAITrack: A target entered Tracked: high, sustained confidence.
UPerceptionCore.OnAILost: A target entered Lost. Gives where it was last placed, where it is predicted to be, and the cover it went behind.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIRemember: A lost target faded to Remembered. Age Seconds is the time since the AI first noticed it.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIForget: The AI let go of a target: it Expired, or dropped back to Undetected.
UPerceptionCore.OnThreatIdentified: A target's threat rose to High or Critical.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIAllClear: No actor is left at Suspected, Detected, Tracked or Lost (Get Active Target Count fell to 0): time to stand down.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIPainReported: Fires for each Report Pain from Definition, on the next update: the pain asset, and its level after that report.
UPerceptionCore.OnAIDamaged: Fires on every Unreal damage call that hits the AI (Apply Damage, Apply Point Damage, Apply Radial Damage), with or without Damage Sense: who did it, how much, the damage type's short tag and where.
UPerceptionCore.OnEmotionalStateChanged: The dominant emotion changed: gives the old one and the new one.
UPerceptionCore.OnAttentionChanged: The AI's focus moved to a different target. Old Target is none the first time. The new target can be one the AI only suspects, so check its state before reacting; to start a chase, use On AI Detect.
UPerceptionCore.OnAISquadAlert: A squadmate told this AI something new: a shared target, or a place and threat (Broadcast Alert to Squad). It doesn't fire again for the same news.
UPerceptionCore.OnReplicatedStateChanged: Fires on clients when a new replicated summary arrives. Not on a listen-server host or in single player.
UPerceptionCore.OnAITelegraph: Fires once when confidence in a target reaches Telegraph Threshold, before the AI commits; again only after it has let that target go. Put a huh? bark or a head turn here.
UPerceptionCore.OnLocationBeliefChanged: A belief about a place (a noise nobody made, a blast) changed state.
UPerceptionCore.ReplicatedTargets: The compact summary of this AI's targets that reaches clients (with Replicate Perception State). Read it with Get Replicated Perception State.
UPerceptionCore.ReplicatedAwareness: This AI's overall awareness, as it reaches clients.
UPerceptionProfile.SenseIntervals: How often each sense updates, in seconds, by sense. A sense not listed uses its own: Vision 0.15, Smell 0.25, Echolocation 0.3, the others 0.1.
UPerceptionProfile.HearingMaxRange: How far hearing reaches when a sound has no Sound Type of its own, and part of how far away AI look for targets at all (cm). Each Sound Type sets how far its sound carries.
UPerceptionProfile.bAutoConfidenceFromDa: On: being hurt raises the AI's confidence in the attacker to the damage taken from them so far ÷ 100, at any range. Off: damage only fires On AI Damaged, and it adds nothing to threat or emotions either.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionHalfAngleDeg: Half the width of the main (focal) vision cone, in degrees: 60 sees 60° to each side.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionSampleCount: How many of the built-in sample points (head, chest, pelvis, shoulders) vision traces, 1 to 5. Only for targets without an APS Target Component and when Default Visibility Samples is empty.
UPerceptionProfile.DarknessMinDetection: How much the AI still sees in total darkness, 0 to 1: 0 is blind in the dark, 1 ignores darkness (infrared).
UPerceptionProfile.EyeHeightOffset: How high the eyes are above the actor's origin, in cm: used without Use Eye Socket, or when the socket doesn't exist.
UPerceptionProfile.EyeTurnRateDegPerSec: How fast the AI's view may turn, in degrees per second. 0 turns instantly (Unreal's own perception snaps to a Move To target before the body has turned). Set it near your character's real turn rate so it can't see you before it has turned to look.
UPerceptionProfile.MinVisiblePoints_Stan: How many of a standing target's sample points must be visible before it registers at all. 1 by default for every stance, so stance changes nothing until you raise these.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionOcclusionChanne: The collision channels that block sight. Empty means Visibility only. A list replaces Visibility, so include it if your walls block it. Each extra channel is one more trace per point.
UPerceptionProfile.bPawnsBlockSight: Bodies block sight: the Pawn channel is traced too, so squadmates hide what is behind them.
UPerceptionProfile.SurfaceVisionTransmis: How much sight passes through each physical surface, 0 to 1: 1 fully see-through (glass), 0.4 partly (foliage, smoke). Surfaces not listed block completely.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionVerticalHalfAng: Half the height of the vision cone, in degrees, with Use Separate Vertical FOV.
UPerceptionProfile.PeripheralHalfAngleDe: Half the width of the side cone, in degrees. It must be wider than Vision Half Angle Deg to add anything.
UPerceptionProfile.PeripheralRangeScale: How far the side cone reaches, as a share of Vision Max Range.
UPerceptionProfile.RearMotionRangeScale: How far the rear cone reaches, as a share of Vision Max Range.
UPerceptionProfile.bTraceSunShadow: With Use Per Target Light: trace from the target toward the sun to see whether it stands in shadow. Needs Set Sun Direction on the APS Subsystem.
UPerceptionProfile.ShadowLightLevel: The light level a target in shadow gets, 0 to 1. Shadow only ever darkens.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionDistanceCurve: Optional: replaces the default distance falloff. X is the distance as a share of the range (0 to 1); Y is how much confidence is left.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionAngleCurve: Optional: replaces the default falloff across the cone. X is the angle as a share of the cone's half-width (0 to 1); Y is how much confidence is left.
UPerceptionProfile.MotionBonusCurve: Optional: replaces the default movement bonus. X is the target's speed in cm/s; Y multiplies confidence (kept between 0.5 and 1.5).
UPerceptionProfile.bKeyholeVision: Make the focal cone wide up close and narrow far away.
UPerceptionProfile.KeyholeNearAngle: Half the cone's width up close (within Keyhole Near Distance), in degrees.
UPerceptionProfile.KeyholeFarAngle: Half the cone's width at full range, in degrees.
UPerceptionProfile.KeyholeNearDistance: Up to this distance (cm) the cone is at its near width; beyond it narrows toward the far width.
UPerceptionProfile.HearingBaseThreshold: Not read by APS 3.0: there is no noise floor.
UPerceptionProfile.bSoundEventOnlyMode: Not read by APS 3.0: hearing always hears only the sounds you emit.
UPerceptionProfile.WallAbsorptionCoeff: How much each wall between a sound and the AI muffles it: each wall multiplies the sound by e to the minus this (0.4 takes about a third off).
UPerceptionProfile.SoundAccumulationRate: How fast repeated sounds build up confidence.
UPerceptionProfile.bEchoDirectional: Echolocation only pings forward: it ignores targets more than about 101° off its facing.
UPerceptionProfile.VisionLoss: How the AI loses a target when vision is the sense that last had it: Grace Time (0.3 s) before it may count as lost, Direct Cut (on: straight to Lost) and how fast belief then fades (× 3).
UPerceptionProfile.HearingLoss: Losing a target heard last: a 3 s grace, steps down through the states rather than cutting to Lost, normal fading (× 1).
UPerceptionProfile.SmellLoss: Losing a target smelled last: a 20 s grace (scent lingers), steps down, slow fading (× 0.3).
UPerceptionProfile.TouchLoss: Losing a target felt last: a 0.5 s grace, steps down, fading × 2.
UPerceptionProfile.VibrationLoss: Losing a target felt through the floor: no grace (stop moving and it's gone), steps down, fast fading (× 5).
UPerceptionProfile.DamageLoss: Losing an attacker: an 8 s grace (it remembers being hit), steps down, slow fading (× 0.5).
UPerceptionProfile.EcholocationLoss: Losing a target pinged last: a 0.6 s grace, straight to Lost, fading × 2.
UPerceptionProfile.CorroborationBonus: What each extra sense that reports a target adds on top of the strongest one. Vision 0.8 alone is 0.8; with hearing too, 0.9. 0 uses the strongest sense alone.
UPerceptionProfile.ConfidenceRiseRate: How fast confidence rises toward what the senses report. Higher is snappier detection.
UPerceptionProfile.StandingDwellRate: Extra confidence per second, while the AI keeps sensing a target standing still: the longer it looks, the surer it gets (never above what the senses report).
UPerceptionProfile.MovingDwellRate: The same for a target moving fast (600 cm/s or more); speeds in between blend the two.
UPerceptionProfile.DecayCurve: Optional: how much of its last confidence the AI keeps (Y) after so many seconds without sensing the target (X). Empty fades exponentially at Default Decay Exponent.
UPerceptionProfile.LongTermDecayCurve: Optional: how much long-term memory strength is left (Y) after so many seconds without sensing the target (X).
UPerceptionProfile.DefaultDecayExponent: How fast belief fades once no sense has the target, when there is no Decay Curve. Higher forgets faster.
UPerceptionProfile.MemoryRefreshBonus: Extra confidence, given once per loss, when the AI senses again a target it had Lost or Remembered: finding you again locks on faster.
UPerceptionProfile.MemoryExpireThreshold: Below this confidence a Remembered target Expires and its slot is freed.
UPerceptionProfile.FullAwareThreshold: The confidence at which the AI's awareness becomes Fully Aware.
UPerceptionProfile.AttentionStickinessTi: The least time, in seconds, the AI stays focused on its attention target before it will consider switching: for example 0.5 for a camera, 2 for a guard, 5 for a zombie.
UPerceptionProfile.AttentionSwitchThresh: How much better a rival must score to take the AI's attention.
UPerceptionProfile.bEnablePrediction: Work out where a lost target is heading: Predicted Position moves ahead of the last known position, along its last movement.
UPerceptionProfile.PredictionHorizon: How far ahead, in seconds, Predicted Position looks along the target's last movement.
UPerceptionProfile.MaxPredictionTime: The longest Prediction Horizon allowed, in seconds.
UPerceptionProfile.VelocityEMAWeight: How quickly the AI's measure of a target's speed follows changes, 0 to 1: lower is smoother, higher reacts faster.
UPerceptionProfile.bAsyncVisionTraces: Run vision's traces off the critical path. The exposure it reports is one vision update old (about 0.15 s). With more than one occlusion channel or any Surface Vision Transmission, APS traces normally anyway.
UPerceptionProfile.bEnableStatisticalTie: Let distant AI (from Statistical Tier Threshold) perceive by chance instead of tracing: cheap, but it doesn't see walls, so a statistical AI can notice through them.
UPerceptionProfile.StatisticalTierThresh: The level of detail tier from which an AI goes statistical. At 3 only distant, unengaged AI do (for an idle AI, beyond about 150 m).
UPerceptionProfile.BaseUpdateInterval: How often perception runs, in seconds. Lower is more reactive and costs more; doubling it halves the cost.
UPerceptionProfile.MaintenanceInterval: How often, in seconds, the AI tidies away beliefs that have expired.
UPerceptionProfile.MaxTrackedTargets: How many beliefs this AI can hold at once. The slots are set up when it starts, so it is memory as well as time.
UPerceptionProfile.bDistanceTickThrottli: Let AI at tier 3 and 4 (far away and idle) update their component only every 0.1 and 0.25 s. Their perception timing doesn't change. For an idle AI those tiers start at about 150 m and 225 m from the nearest camera.
UPerceptionProfile.SortWeightConfidence: How much confidence counts in a target's sort score (which picks the top target and who keeps a slot in a crowd).
UPerceptionProfile.SortWeightRecency: How much having sensed the target recently counts in its sort score.
UPerceptionProfile.SortWeightProximity: How much being close counts in its sort score.
UPerceptionProfile.MaxSortDistance: Beyond this distance (cm) being close adds nothing to the sort score.
UPerceptionProfile.MaxFear: The highest fear can climb to, 0 to 1. 0 turns fear off.
UPerceptionProfile.FearRiseRate: How fast fear rises, per second, while the AI has been hurt by one of its targets, believes in more than two actors (allies count), faces a Critical threat, or has a Fear Input above 0. Fear Input also multiplies this rate.
UPerceptionProfile.FearDecayRate: How fast fear falls, per second, once the AI believes in no one. While anyone remains, fear holds.
UPerceptionProfile.PanicRiseRate: How fast panic rises, per second, while fear is above 0.8 with more than one target, or Fear Input is above 0.9.
UPerceptionProfile.PanicDecayRate: How fast panic falls, per second, once fear is below 0.5 and Fear Input below 0.3.
UPerceptionProfile.EmotionActiveThreshol: An emotion must be above this to be the dominant emotion; when none is, the AI is Calm.
UPerceptionProfile.PanicOverrideThreshol: Above this, panic is the dominant emotion whatever the others are.
UPerceptionProfile.ThreatDamageDecayRate: How fast the damage a target did fades from its threat score once the target is Lost, Remembered or Expired, per second. 0 never forgets.
UPerceptionProfile.SquadShareRange: How far, in cm, a share reaches: the squad's radio range.
UPerceptionProfile.MinThreatToShare: The least threat level a target needs before this AI shares it with its squad.
UPerceptionProfile.bAutoShareOnDetect: Share a target with the squad by itself as soon as it is Detected: one sees you, the pack comes. Off: share it yourself (Share Target with Squad).
UPerceptionProfile.bAutoShareOnTrack: Share by itself when a target is Tracked instead. Works only with Auto Share on Detect off.
UPerceptionProfile.EligibleRoles: The combat roles this kind of AI may claim. Empty means any.
UPerceptionProfile.bEnablePlayerBehavior: Record how each target plays, for the session: crouch, walk and sprint shares, how encounters ended, where it hid. Your logic reads it (Get Player Behavior Model); APS doesn't change behaviour by itself.
UPerceptionProfile.MinEngagementsRequire: How many encounters before the player model's Has Enough Data turns true.
UPerceptionProfile.PlayerCrouchSpeedThre: When no posture is reported, a target slower than this (cm/s) counts as crouching for the player model.
UPerceptionProfile.PlayerSprintSpeedThre: A target faster than this (cm/s) counts as sprinting for the player model.
UPerceptionProfile.MemoryRetentionSecond: Seconds a memory (Remember) lasts without being written again. 0 keeps it for the whole session.
UPerceptionProfile.PainVisionFloor: The least that pain or low health can dull vision to, 0 to 1. Other senses can go to 0.
UPerceptionProfile.bAutoWireOverlapAsGra: Treat the AI's overlaps as a held Grab, not only its blocking hits as Bumps.
UPerceptionProfile.FirstSpotReactionTime: Seconds the AI must keep sensing a target it doesn't know yet before confidence starts to count: a beat for the player to step back. Only until it first suspects that target. 0 is instant.
UPerceptionProfile.TelegraphThreshold: The confidence at which On AI Telegraph fires: a warning before the AI commits. Keep it between Suspect Threshold and Detect Threshold.
UPerceptionProfile.bOffscreenHearingPena: Hear worse while this AI is off the first player's screen (more than about 75° from where the camera points).
UPerceptionProfile.OffscreenHearingMulti: How much of its hearing an off-screen AI keeps, 0 to 1.
UPerceptionProfile.bRespectNeverSearchZo: Whether this AI's Is Location in Never Search Zone answers. Off: it always answers false. APS enforces nothing by itself.
UPerceptionProfile.bUseReplicationReleva: Leave out of the replicated summary targets nobody is near (Replication Relevance Range) or that it barely suspects (Replication Min Confidence).
UPerceptionProfile.ReplicationRelevanceR: A target whose believed position is further than this (cm) from every player camera is left out. 0 turns the distance test off.
UPerceptionProfile.ReplicationMinConfide: Targets below this confidence are left out of the replicated summary.
UPerceptionProfile.bSkipUnchangedReplica: Send nothing when nothing changed by more than Replication Confidence Delta.
UAPSQualityProfile.SenseIntervalScale: Multiplies every sense's update interval: thin out vision without slowing the rest.
UAPSQualityProfile.bSkipPerTargetLight: Skip the per-target light and sun-shadow trace and use the world's light. This changes stealth: a target in shadow reads as lit. Only for AI nobody watches closely.
UAPSTargetComponent.bAutoDetectStance: Work out the posture automatically: an APSStance Provider if the actor has one, else the Character's crouch.
UAPSTargetComponent.VisibilityMultiplier: How visible this actor is, 0 to 1: camouflage, tall grass, a cloak. 0 makes it invisible to sight.
UAPSTargetComponent.LightLevelOverride: How lit this actor is, 0 to 1, from your own light gem: it wins over everything. -1 lets APS work it out.
FEmotionalState.DominantEmotion: The emotion that leads now: Calm, Curious, Alert, Aggressive, Fearful or Panicked.
FEmotionalState.FearInput: The outside fear set by Set Fear Input, 0 to 1.
FSenseImpairEntry.Effect: How much this pain dulls the sense, 0 to 1: at full pain, 1 takes the sense to its floor.
UPainTypeDefinition.DecayRate: How much of the level is lost per second, in a straight line: 0.05 lingers (bleeding), 0.2 fades (burning), 1 is quick (a stun). 0 never fades: clear it with Clear Pain from Definition.
UPainTypeDefinition.MaxLevel: The highest this pain can reach, 0 to 1, however many reports land.
UPainTypeDefinition.AmountOverride: Above 0, every report adds this instead of the amount passed: for all-or-nothing pain like a flash. 0 uses the amount passed.
FAPSProfileOverride.Property: The setting's override name, shown on the profile reference: for example VisionMaxRange, or bEnablePeripheralCone for a tickbox.
FAPSProfileOverride.Number: The value, for a number setting (a choice uses its position in the list, from 0).
FAPSVisibilitySample.Weight: How much this point counts, 0 to 1: a visible head counts for more than a visible foot.
FAPSPerceptionFrame.ActiveSenseCount: In APS 3.0, how many senses the AI runs (not how many were reporting).
FPerceptionSenseResult.ExposureRatio: Vision only: how much of the target was visible, 0 (hidden) to 1 (fully in view), weighted by its sample points.
FPerceptionSenseResult.Blocker: Why the sense reported nothing, when it reported nothing. Only Vision gives reasons (and pain or the reaction window, for any sense).
FPerceptionSenseResult.bWasActiveLastEva: What this sense said the last time it actually ran. Senses run on their own intervals, so between their updates Is Active is false; this tells you whether it still has the target.
FBeliefRecord.SubjectKind: Whether this belief is about an actor (someone), a thing (APS Evidence) or a place.
FBeliefRecord.SubjectLocation: Where a belief about a place is. For a belief about an actor, read Last Known Position.
FBeliefRecord.LossReason: Why the AI last lost this target (Occluded, OutOfRange, SoundFaded, ScentLost, SensorDropout, TargetDestroyed). Cleared when it is found again. Branch your search on it.
FBeliefRecord.LossDirection: Which way the target was moving when it was last lost, from its last measured velocity. (0, 0, 0) when it wasn't moving.
FBeliefRecord.Episodes: The last five encounters with this target, oldest first: each written when the AI lost the target from Detected or Tracked. Read them with Get Recent Episodes.
FPerceptionContext.OwnerEyeForward: The direction the AI's eyes face, with Eye Direction Mode and Eye Turn Rate applied: use it rather than the actor's rotation.
FPerceptionContext.bOwnerOffscreen: True when this AI is off the first player's screen (more than about 75° from where the camera points). Used by Offscreen Hearing Penalty.
FPerceptionContext.QualityMaxVisionSampl: The Quality Profile's cap on sample points: 0 for no cap.
FSenseLossConfig.GraceTime: Seconds after the sense stops reporting before the target can be lost. Brief cover (a pillar, a doorframe) doesn't drop it.
FSenseLossConfig.bDirectCut: On: once the grace ends, straight to Lost (vision, echolocation). Off: confidence steps down through the states first (the other senses).
FSenseLossConfig.ConfidenceDecayMultipli: How fast belief fades once this sense has stopped, compared with normal (1): 3 fades three times as fast.
FAPSEvidence.Source: A free label for your own debugging: Disguise, Dispatch, Cutscene_03.
FAPSStimulusEvent.StimulusTag: A dotted name for the signal. Senses listen for a beginning, so one listening for Stimulus.Custom gets Stimulus.Custom.Psychic.
FAPSStimulusEvent.Radius: AI further than this (cm) don't receive it.
FAPSStimulusEvent.MaxLODTier: AI at a higher (cheaper) level of detail tier don't receive it: 4 reaches every AI.
FAPSStimulusEvent.bRequiresClearPath: Trace from the signal to each AI and skip those behind a wall. Costs a trace per AI: only for signals walls should stop.
FAPSStimulusEvent.bTeamFilter: Skip AI on the Source's team.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.CrouchRatio: Share of the time, during encounters, the target spent crouched or prone.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.SprintRatio: Share of the time, during encounters, the target spent sprinting.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.WalkRatio: Share of the time, during encounters, the target spent walking.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.StealthRatio: Share of encounters that ended with the target behind the AI.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.AggressionRatio: Share of encounters that ended with the target in front. It and Stealth Ratio add up to 1.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.RecentHideLocations: Up to 5 different places (each more than 2 m from the others) where the AI lost the target.
FPlayerBehaviorModel.bHasEnoughData: True once Engagement Count reaches the profile's Min Engagements Required: check it before your logic adapts.
URelationshipComponent.TeamRelationships: A team id (Unreal's Generic Team Id, from the target or its controller) and the relationship it means.
URelationshipComponent.ClassRelationship: An actor class and the relationship it means. Class rules win over team rules.
USenseUnit.LossGraceTime: Seconds after this sense stops reporting before the target can be lost.
USenseUnit_Smell.WindDirection: This sense's own wind: the way the air moves (1, 0, 0 carries scent toward +X). (0, 0, 0) uses the world's wind (Set Wind State, or an APS Environment).
USenseUnit_Smell.DownwindBonus: How much stronger the scent is when the wind carries it straight to the AI: 2 is twice as strong.
USenseUnit_Smell.ScentThreshold: Divides the scent intensity: lower is more sensitive.
USoundTypeDefinition.MaxPendingPerTick: How many sounds of this type wait for an AI per update. Past that, the quietest is replaced by a louder one.
USoundTypeDefinition.MaxLODTier: AI at a higher (cheaper) level of detail tier ignore this sound: 1 for a footstep, 3 for a gunshot, 4 for an explosion everyone should hear.
USoundFilterProfile.bFilterFriendlyTeam: Ignore sounds from the AI's own team (its Generic Team Id, or its controller's; for a projectile, whoever launched it).
UAPSSubsystem.MaxPerceptionUpdatesPerFra: The most AI that run a full perception update in one frame. 0 is unlimited. AI over the cap wait (they are never dropped), most overdue and most significant first.
EAPSBeliefSubject.Location: A place something happened, with nobody known behind it.
EAPSBeliefSubject.Object: A thing, not someone: a body, a forced lock (APS Evidence, Set Perceived as Object). Never a target.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker: Why a sense reported nothing about a target.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.None: Nothing blocked it (or it reported the target). In view but too faint (far, dark) also counts here.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.OutsideCone: In range, but outside every vision cone.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.Occluded: Something solid in the way: no sample point visible.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.BelowExposure: Visible, but less of it than Min Exposure to Register.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.InsufficientPoints: Some points visible, but fewer than the target's stance needs.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.TargetOptedOut: The target's APS Target Component has Visibility Multiplier 0.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.SuppressedByPain: Pain or low health dulled the sense to nothing.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.FairnessHold: First Spot Reaction Time is still running: on purpose.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.NotEvaluated: Never reported in APS 3.0: a sense keeps its last answer between updates.
EAPSPerceptionBlocker.NoContext: No belief about that target, or no such sense on this AI.
EBeliefLifecycleState: Where a belief is in its life, from Undetected to Expired.
EBeliefLifecycleState.Suspected: Something is there: confidence at Suspect Threshold or above.
EBeliefLifecycleState.Detected: It is sure the target is there: Detect Threshold or above.
EBeliefLifecycleState.Tracked: High, sustained confidence: Track Threshold, for at least Min Track Duration.
EBeliefLifecycleState.Lost: The senses lost the target; the AI knows where it last was, and why it lost it.
EBeliefLifecycleState.Remembered: Faded to memory: it still knows the target was there.
ELossReason: Why the AI lost a target.
ELossReason.Occluded: It went behind something: search that cover.
ELossReason.OutOfRange: It walked out of range or out of the cones: go on along Loss Direction.
ELossReason.SoundFaded: Its noise stopped: look around there, don't chase.
ELossReason.ScentLost: The trail went cold: follow Loss Direction.
ELossReason.SensorDropout: The sense just stopped: too dark, cloaked, blinded, or a sense like touch or vibration went quiet.
EAwarenessLevel: How alert the AI is overall, from its most confident belief.
EAwarenessLevel.Peripheral: At Suspect Threshold or above: something on the edge of notice.
EAwarenessLevel.FullyAware: At Full Aware Threshold or above.
EStimulusSource: Which kind of evidence a belief came from.
EStimulusSource.Unknown: None of the others: touch, vibration, echolocation or a custom sense.
EStimulusSource.Damage: It was hurt by the target.
EThreatLevel: How dangerous the AI thinks a target is, from its threat score and the profile's thresholds.
EThreatLevel.None: No threat (also always for Friendly, Teammate and Expired targets).
EThreatLevel.Low: Score at Threat Threshold Low or above.
EThreatLevel.Medium: Score at Threat Threshold Medium or above.
EThreatLevel.High: Score at Threat Threshold High or above.
EThreatLevel.Critical: Score at Threat Threshold Critical or above.
ETargetRelationship: What the AI takes a target for (from APS Relationship).
ETargetRelationship.Neutral: Civilians, wildlife: perceived, not threatening. Threat weight 0.3.
ETargetRelationship.Friendly: An allied faction: never a threat.
ETargetRelationship.Teammate: Its own side: never a threat.
ETargetRelationship.HighValue: A priority target: a VIP, an objective carrier. Threat weight 1.2.
ETargetRelationship.Feared: Something to run from. Threat weight 1.5, the most.
EEmotionType.Calm: No emotion above Emotion Active Threshold.
EEmotionType.Panicked: Panic is above Panic Override Threshold: it wins over everything.
ECombatRole: A role one squad member at a time can hold. APS gives roles no behaviour: your logic does.
EContactType: What kind of contact touch felt. When several land in one update, the strongest kind counts: Explosion, then Grab, Collision, Bump.
EContactType.Bump: Walked into: stronger the faster it moved.
EContactType.Grab: Held contact: an overlap, a grab.
ESurfaceType: What a target is moving on, for vibration (from the target's Surface.Metal, Surface.Water or Surface.Ground actor tag).
EAPSEyeDirectionMode.ActorRotation: The actor's facing. Cheapest; the default.
EAPSEyeDirectionMode.ControlRotation: The controller's control rotation (what Unreal's own perception uses).
EAPSEyeDirectionMode.SocketRotation: The eye socket's facing: it follows the head bone's animation.
EAPSEyeDirectionMode.Blended: A blend of the actor's and the socket's facing (Eye Socket Rotation Weight).
EAPSEyeSocketAlignment: How the eye socket's rotation becomes a look direction.
EAPSEyeSocketAlignment.Automatic: Works it out from the skeleton's rest pose: a plain bone name like head works on any rig.
EAPSEyeSocketAlignment.RawRotation: Uses the socket's rotation exactly: for a socket you made and pointed yourself.
EAPSArchetype: A preset Apply Archetype stamps onto a profile.
EAPSArchetype.Guard: Alert and forward-facing: commits to a contact quickly and keeps it.
EAPSArchetype.Civilian: Wide senses, high thresholds, short memory: reacts without investigating.
EAPSArchetype.Stalker: A narrow, long look and a memory that doesn't let go.
EAPSArchetype.Patrol: The longest sight; shares contacts with the squad.
EAPSArchetype.Wildlife: Smell and hearing over sight; reacts long before it is sure.
EAPSStance: A target's posture: how many sample points must show before it counts (the profile's Min Visible Points).
EAPSVisionCone: Which vision cone saw the target.
EAPSViewPointState.Seen: More than half of sight reaches the point.
EAPSViewPointState.Partly: Some sight gets through (glass, leaves, smoke), too little to count.
EAPSEvidenceOp: What a piece of evidence does to belief.
EAPSEvidenceOp.Raise: Belief is at least Value. Gives the AI a belief if it had none.
EAPSEvidenceOp.Clamp: Belief is at most Value, even while the AI senses the target.
EAPSEvidenceOp.Lower: Belief settles Value below what the senses say, while a sense reports the target.
EAPSEvidenceOp.Invalidate: Belief is held at 0: it steps back down.
EPainState: A band of health (C++ only: Get Pain State).
ESoundCategory: What made a sound, for filters.
ESoundAlertLevel: How alarming a sound is, for filters.
EAPSCommsChannel: How a report reaches a faction: the slower ones lose time, precision and detail, and can be cut off.
EAPSCommsChannel.Direct: Seen first-hand: at once and complete.
EAPSCommsChannel.Shout: 0.5 s late, up to 3 m off, a quarter of the detail lost.
EAPSCommsChannel.Radio: 2 s late, up to 6 m off, 35% of the detail lost.
EAPSCommsChannel.Report: In person: 8 s late, up to 15 m off, over half the detail lost.
FAPSDescriptor: A set of traits: what someone really is (an APS Signature), or what a witness made out. The same type serves both, so one can be matched against the other.
FAPSEvidence: One piece of scripted evidence about a target (Add Target Evidence): what it does to belief, by how much, and for how long.
FAPSMemorySubject: What a memory is about: an actor, or a place with a Place Tag. Build one with Make Actor Subject or Make Place Subject.
FAPSPerceptionFrame: One target's belief at one moment, from a recording (Start Recording).
FAPSProfileOverride: One changed profile setting, by its override name: a number or a tickbox. Used by a profile's Overrides and an APS Core's Profile Overrides.
FAPSReplicatedTargetState: One target as clients see it, in the replicated summary (Get Replicated Perception State).
FAPSSenseSample: One sense's reading, as a Fusion Policy sees it.
FAPSStimulusEvent: A signal for the stimulus bus (Emit Stimulus): what it is, where, how strong, and who receives it.
FAPSTrait: One thing a witness could describe about someone: a key (Coat), a value (Red), and how easy it is to notice.
FAPSViewFan: One view cone as a flat shape: from the Apex, a fan whose edge (the Rim) stops where sight stops, at a wall, past glass, or at full range.
FAPSVisibilitySample: One point on a target that vision traces to: a mesh socket, or an offset from the actor when there is no socket.
FBeliefRecord: Everything an AI believes about one target (Get Belief Data).
FEmotionalState: The AI's five emotions (each 0 to 1), the dominant one, and the fear input.
FEnvironmentState: The world's conditions as APS uses them: light, rain, wind, indoors and time of day.
FPerceptionContext: What a sense knows about the AI and the moment when it judges a target (for your own senses).
FPerceptionEpisode: One past encounter with a target, written when the AI lost it from Detected or Tracked. The last five are kept (Get Recent Episodes).
FPerceptionSenseResult: What one sense reported about one target (Get Sense Result; your own sense fills one in).
FPlayerBehaviorModel: What an AI has recorded about how a target plays (Get Player Behavior Model).
FSenseImpairEntry: One sense a pain type dulls, and how much.
FSenseLossConfig: How the AI loses a target when this sense is the one that last had it.
UAPSPerceptionListener.OnAttentionChange: The AI's focus moved to a different target. Old Target is none the first time. The new target can be one the AI only suspects, so check its state before reacting; to start a chase, use On AI Detect.
USenseUnit_Pain.GetHealthRatio: The health fraction the Pain sense uses, 0 to 1: read each update from the APSHealth Provider interface or a health function on the pawn, else as set by Set Health Ratio.
UPerceptionProfile.bUseEyeSocket: Take the eye position from a mesh socket instead of Eye Height Offset: sight then starts where the head really is, as it animates.
UPerceptionProfile.EyeSocketAlignment: How the socket's rotation becomes a look direction. On Automatic you can name a plain bone (head, eyes) and APS works out how it is oriented from the skeleton's rest pose: the cone starts along the character's forward and follows the bone.
UPerceptionProfile.EyeSocketRotationOffs: A correction you set by hand, used only when Eye Socket Alignment is Manual Offset: it turns the socket's forward onto the character's forward.
UPerceptionProfile.EyeSocketRotationWeig: With Eye Direction Mode Blended: how much of the facing comes from the socket, 0 (all actor) to 1 (all socket).
UPerceptionProfile.MinExposureToRegister: How much of a target must be visible (0 to 1, weighted by its points) before it counts as seen at all. 0: one visible point is enough. Raise it so a sliver of shoulder behind cover isn't seen.
UPerceptionProfile.bEnableSpatialModel: Keep track of where targets are: Last Known Position, Uncertainty Radius and Predicted Position.
FPerceptionContext.DeltaTime: The length of this update, in seconds.
FAPSStimulusEvent.Source: The actor that caused the signal; none for things like weather.
USoundTypeDefinition.LocationAccuracyOve: How precisely a hearer places this sound, 0 to 1: 0.9 a gunshot, 0.2 a distant thud. 0 works it out from the distance.
UAPSDebugHelper.SimulateSquadShare: Hand Sender's belief about Target to Receiver, as a squad share would, without Receiver perceiving anything. Sender must hold a belief about Target. For testing sharing with one pair of AI.
FBeliefRecord.LongTermMemoryStrength: A slow memory of the target, 0 to 1: it builds by 0.02 a second while the target is sensed and fades by about 1% a second after (or as Long Term Decay Curve says). APS itself doesn't act on it: read it for your own logic.
FPerceptionEpisode.PeakThreatLevel: The threat level at the moment the AI lost the target. Despite the name, not the highest of the encounter.
FPerceptionEpisode.EngagementDuration: All the time this target has spent Tracked so far, in seconds, not just this encounter: it only grows.
